Keith Elwin at IFPA 18 World Pinball Championship — Quarterfinals
Pinballso Godzilla Saucer Attack Shatz-pass demonstration

strategy.summary: Use the ramp shots during Gigan to prepare Godzilla Multiball, move to London, then start Titanosaurus before the multiball. Finish Titanosaurus under multiball protection, collect six Godzilla jackpots, and shoot the building for the Super Jackpot.

steps.text: Shoot either ramp twice to light Battle at the scoop. Shoot the scoop and use the flippers or action button to select Gigan.
modeNotes: Gigan is the recommended opener because every required ramp also damages the building for Godzilla Multiball.
The battle lasts 60 seconds and requires eight ramp shots in any combination.

steps.text: Make eight ramp shots to finish Gigan. Alternate ramps when possible because the combo scores more.
modeNotes: A ramp starts at 1,000,000 and rises by 500,000. An opposite-ramp combo scores double.
A combo final blow scores 4x. A non-combo final blow scores 2x.
If time ends, battle progress persists but the shot value resets.

steps.text: Shoot the scoop for City Select and choose London. Then shoot both ramps to light the next Battle.
modeNotes: City Select lights after a Battle begins. You do not need to complete the Battle before changing cities.
London adds a fixed bonus to later Destruction Jackpots.
Changing cities collects the Carnage Bonus built from city destruction.
After the first Battle, you must shoot both ramps to light another Battle.
A Tier 1 Battle must start before multiball to continue into it. Tier 2 Battles take priority over other scoring features.

steps.text: Shoot the scoop and use the flippers or action button to select Titanosaurus. Let the Battle begin before starting Godzilla Multiball.
modeNotes: A Tier 1 Battle cannot start during multiball. If it starts first, it continues during multiball.
During Titanosaurus, shoot the three blue powerline targets from left to right, then Maser Cannon, then the captive ball.
Mecha-target hits add 500,000 to the next Titanosaurus shot.

steps.text: If an Ally is lit and the building is ready, choose whether to collect Mothra or Rodan before starting the multiball.
modeNotes: Use the right flipper to cycle the lit Ally, then shoot the scoop to collect it.
Mothra: Choose it first when a stored left-outlane save will help you survive.
Rodan 2x playfield scoring: Choose it immediately before the stack when you want 60 seconds of 2x scoring. It starts as soon as you collect it.
Anguirus: Choose it when you want to store an action-button add-a-ball for any multiball. Multiple awards can be stored.
Completing at least half of a Battle, or another listed task, lights an Ally at the scoop.

steps.text: Damage the building to zero. Start Godzilla Multiball at the building immediately after Titanosaurus begins.
modeNotes: Hit either ramp or the Building toy to damage upper and middle floors. Hit the Building toy to damage lower floors.
On Pro, the next building shot starts multiball after the building reaches zero health.
On Premium or LE, hit the Building toy three times after its health reaches zero; each hit locks a ball, and the third starts multiball.

steps.text: During the overlap, finish Titanosaurus first while collecting the six lit Godzilla jackpots. Then shoot the building for the Super Jackpot.
modeNotes: For Titanosaurus, shoot the three blue targets from left to right, then Maser Cannon, then the captive ball.
Each Godzilla jackpot shot advances its own multiplier from 1x to 5x.
The Super value is the total of the six jackpots. Each complete set adds 1x to later Supers.
Hit any three green Neo Barrier targets, then shoot the right spinner to add a ball.

quickInfo.name: Gigan
quickInfo.summary: Shoot either ramp twice, start at the scoop, select Gigan, then make eight ramp shots that also damage the building.

quickInfo.name: Titanosaurus
quickInfo.summary: In London, shoot both ramps, start the Battle at the scoop, then carry its five ordered shots into Godzilla Multiball.

quickInfo.name: Godzilla Multiball
quickInfo.summary: Damage the building to zero, start multiball there, collect six jackpots, then take the building Super Jackpot.

quickInfo.name: Allies
quickInfo.summary: Choose Mothra for a left-outlane save, Rodan for immediate 60-second 2x scoring, or Anguirus for a stored add-a-ball.

quickInfo.name: Mechagodzilla Multiball
quickInfo.summary: Build right-spinner and Neo Barrier progress, then start at the right spinner on Pro or jump ramp on Premium and LE.

quickInfo.name: Tesla Strike
quickInfo.summary: Complete the three blue Powerline targets twice, then hit the roving flashing target five times; the fifth hit starts Tesla Strike.

quickInfo.name: Bridge Attack Multiball
quickInfo.summary: Build 50 switch hits and hit the lit captive ball four times, rebuilding the switches before each hit. Then shoot the right ramp on Pro, or whichever Bridge Out ramp flashes on Premium or LE.

quickInfo.name: Tank Attack Multiball
quickInfo.summary: Destroy 10 tanks at the two lit green TANK shots, then shoot the scoop.

quickInfo.name: Planet X Multiball
quickInfo.summary: Start a Tier 2 Kaiju Battle, Tesla Strike, Bridge Attack Multiball, and Tank Attack Multiball. When City Select lights, shoot the scoop and choose Planet X.

quickInfo.name: Saucer Attack Multiball
quickInfo.summary: Destroy six lit saucers, then hit the pop bumper once more to start Multiball. A Shatz pass up the right inlane into the pop bumper counts as two saucers for one lit attack.

fallback.title: Mechagodzilla Multiball
fallback.when: Use this plan when ramp combos and the building return are not controlled.

steps.text: Make 20 right-spinner hits for the first attempt. Later attempts need 10 more hits.
Hit the spinner once more to deploy the Neo Barrier.
On Pro, hit two green standups and the right spinner. On Premium or LE, hit all three green targets.
Start at the right spinner on Pro. Start at the jump ramp on Premium or LE.
Alternate the ramps and building with the three blue Mecha targets for six jackpots.
The third and fourth jackpots score 2x. The fifth and sixth score 3x.
After all six jackpots, shoot either spinner to build the Super Jackpot.
Collect the Super at the right spinner for 1x, or shoot Tail Whip from the upper flipper for 3x.

alternatives.title: Heat Ray collect-all
alternatives.when: Use this whenever the action button flashes blue, especially when several Battle or multiball shots are lit.

steps.text: Hold the action button until the Heat Ray meter reaches 100 percent.
modeNotes: Heat Ray: A stored collect-all award. The first charge needs 60 center-spinner spins. Later charges need more.
It collects lit playfield shots, but it does not collect the Destruction Jackpot.

steps.text: Use Heat Ray during the overlap to collect several lit Titanosaurus or Godzilla Multiball shots at once.
Start a Tier 2 Kaiju Battle. To reach Tier 2, start a Tier 1 Battle, change cities, and complete at least half of another Tier 1 Battle in the new city.
Start Tesla Strike by completing the three blue Powerline targets twice, then hitting the roving flashing target five times.

Start Bridge Attack Multiball by repeating 50 switch hits and the lit captive ball until four captive-ball hits destroy the bridge. Then shoot the right ramp on Pro, or whichever Bridge Out ramp flashes on Premium or LE.
Start Tank Attack Multiball: destroy 10 tanks at the two lit green TANK shots, then shoot the scoop.
After all four features have started, relight City Select. Shoot the scoop and choose Planet X to start Planet X Multiball.

editionDifferences.pro: After the building reaches zero health, the next building shot starts multiball.
editionDifferences.premium: After the building reaches zero health, three building shots lock three balls and start multiball.

editionDifferences.pro: After Neo Barrier deploys, hit two green standups and the right spinner; start at the right spinner.
editionDifferences.premium: After Neo Barrier deploys, hit all three green targets; start at the jump ramp.

techniques.name: Spinner-to-Mecha bounce
techniques.instruction: Shoot the center spinner. Hold the upper flipper so the ball can bounce toward the upper Mecha targets.

techniques.name: Scoop aiming mark
techniques.instruction: From a left-flipper cradle, use the Z in GODZILLA as the scoop aiming reference.

techniques.name: Saucer Attack Shatz pass
techniques.instruction: When Saucer Attack is lit and the ball rolls through the left inlane, make a Shatz pass up the right inlane into the pop bumper to destroy two saucers instead of one.

cautions.issue: The scoop pop-out can return unpredictably.
cautions.response: Let the return settle. Regain control before the next ramp or building shot.

cautions.issue: The Saucer Attack Shatz pass is valuable but difficult and layout-specific.
cautions.response: Use it when the inlane feed presents the move; do not leave the main Battle and building route solely to force it.

checkBeforePlay: Battle requirements, Multiball thresholds, ball saves, and awards can change with operator settings.
A Tier 1 Battle must start before multiball to continue into it. Tier 2 Battles take priority over other scoring features.
Test both ramps, scoop pop-out, building return, Mecha targets, captive ball, spinners, and edition-specific mechanisms before choosing the route.
strategy.overview: Godzilla turns Gigan ramps into building damage before Titanosaurus enters Multiball. Shoot either ramp twice, shoot the scoop for Gigan, make eight ramps, move to London, shoot both ramps, then shoot the scoop for Titanosaurus. On Pro, shoot the building at zero health to start Multiball. On Premium or LE, shoot the building for three locks. Finish Titanosaurus, collect six jackpots, then shoot the building for Super Jackpot.
strategy.simpleOverview: Godzilla lets a Battle continue into Multiball only when the Battle starts first; Battle shots also damage buildings. Shoot either ramp twice, shoot the scoop, choose Gigan, and make eight ramps to damage the building. On Pro, shoot the building at zero health to start Godzilla Multiball. On Premium or LE, shoot the building for three locks. Collect six Jackpots, then shoot the building for the Super Jackpot.

noteDetails.label: Top-player proof
items: At the IFPA 18 quarterfinal, Keith Elwin started Titanosaurus before Godzilla Multiball in London, finished the Battle during the overlap, and reached 478 million.
